D5/S1/Recurrence/NormOneTraceAddition.tr.name: D5.S1.Recurrence.NormOneTraceAddition.trace_recurrence
D5/S1/Recurrence/NormOneTraceAddition.tr.signature: theorem trace_recurrence (a b : R) (hab : a * b = 1) (m : Nat) : a ^ (m + 2) + b ^ (m + 2) = (a + b) * (a ^ (m + 1) + b ^ (m + 1)) - (a ^ m + b ^ m)
